title: Starbuncles
subtitle: Cannot evolve into a Sylveon :/
description:
Starbuncles can move items between chests and collect Source Berries! To tell one where to deposit the items, use the Dominion Wand, and to obtain a starbuncle token in the first place, give a wild starbuncle a gold nugget.

§oNota Bene:§r if you like the color of a wild starbuncle, nametag it before giving it a gold nugget - this will give you a named token, which when converted into a charm will summon a starbuncle of the same name and color!
